## Featured Projects
- **toof-os** (https://github.com/o-thiago/toof-os): Declarative NixOS configuration tailored for Raspberry Pi 4 boards with VC4 DRM GPU drivers and custom modules.
- **gpm-cards** (https://github.com/o-thiago/gpm-cards): Full-stack credential and showcase platform for GPMecatrônica with Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Nix process-compose services.
- **sqlx-conditional-queries-layering** (https://github.com/o-thiago/sqlx-conditional-queries-layering): Metaprogramming macro engine in Rust for composable, layered, and mergeable conditional SQL query templates on top of SQLx. Author: @o-thiago.
- **Innovation Radar**: Institutional web platform for tracking research projects and IP at IFRO with React, Laravel, Docker.
